chunks: When (Hell) appears to them from a distance they will hear it raging and roaring.
ai.seo_question: What do the people of Hell hear when they see it from a distance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'rage and heavy breathing' (taghayuth wa zafir) are interpreted as the Hellfire's personified reaction to the arrival of the wicked, reflecting the divine justice that matches the intensity of their sins. This auditory imagery serves as a psychological torment, emphasizing that the punishment is not merely physical but also a manifestation of the cosmic order's response to disobedience.
